outside_hall.name: Outside Hall
outside_hall.description: A boundary you stand outside of, and the two things a formal system can do about a hole in it. TWO tokens declare `outside` (quotation | margin | breach | omission | habitat) identically and nothing else in the corpus declares the word: godel_statement_plaque and russell_set_box. The vocabulary genuinely has ONE implementation - russell_set_box.gd:17 preloads the plaque and calls Outside.normalise_outside (:149), outside_mat / outside_box, outside_measure (:210-221), outside_cage (:279) and outside_field (:290-293) - so four of the five words do the same work in both files and the hypothesis mostly holds. THE EXCEPTION IS THE FINDING, AND IT IS ONE WORD. On 2026-07-31 the plaque's `breach` was rewritten (godel_statement_plaque.gd:69-81, :300-315): it used to crack the plate, and the repair note argues that damage is the popular misreading of 1931, that an incomplete system 'is not injured. It is working correctly and cannot certify itself', and replaces the crack with two intact plates each carrying the seal the OTHER issued beside its own empty socket. The note then states at :78-81 that nothing was renamed 'so russell_set_box.gd's word list is untouched and the pair still speak one vocabulary.' The word list is untouched. The vocabulary is not: russell_set_box.gd:228-267 still builds the crack - the shell sprung into two halves at 5.0/3.5 and -6.5/-5.0 degrees out of true, the inner colour lit along the split, three shards on the floor. So `breach` means 'the body failed' in one file and 'the body is intact and cannot certify itself' in the other, and check_dna_declarations.py cannot see it, because the gate compares a registry list against an @export_enum and both files still spell the five words identically. A gate on WORDS is blind to a split in MEANING, which is the same shape of fault this programme keeps finding in its own instruments. AND THE DIVERGENCE IS RIGHT, which is why it earns a bench instead of a bug report. The two files' own truth lines already say so. russell_set_box.gd:27: naive set theory is INCONSISTENT, the paradox 'destroyed the foundations of mathematics in 1901'. godel_statement_plaque.gd:21: completeness and consistency are mutually exclusive - a theorem. Russell's paradox really is a break; S = { x | x not in x } cannot exist, the wall really did fail, and the response was to change the rules until the object is not formable. Type theory, then ZFC. It worked, and nobody has found another Russell. Godel's G is not a break at all: well formed, TRUE, unprovable, and adding it as an axiom hands the larger system its own G. There is nothing to fence. So the plaque's repair was not a better rendering of the same value - it was the discovery of a SECOND QUESTION, not what shape the hole has but whether closing it holds, and a second question is a second axis. This hall declares it: `outside` keeps the family's five forms verbatim and inherits their four builders, and `remedy` (none | fence | reissue) photographs what was done about the hole. `fence` fills the aperture's own footprint with patch material and PAVES the exterior ground to the hall's level and colour out to the rim: one floor, no outside. `reissue` lays the same patch, does not pave, builds a second boundary further out in the same material, and gives that boundary THE SAME APERTURE. The patch is drawn in russell_set_box's own outer_color and the recurring marks in godel_statement_plaque's own glow_color, so the whole argument is made in the sources' two palettes and nothing about it is invented here.
dev_themes: one word, two meanings, and the gate compares words
a repair that was really an axis split
a contradiction can be legislated away and an undecidable sentence cannot
the patch is a visible added axiom, not a restoration
outside_hall.capacity: SEE that the family's five forms of a hole are a question about SHAPE, and that the question the curriculum actually ends on is a question about CONSEQUENCE: walk `remedy` at any form and watch the same patch hold once and fail once
interactions: stand at the default cell - outside=quotation, remedy=none - and read what both sources ship. An intact boundary, dark unpaved ground outside it, and a small plate carrying four raised bars that you cannot read. That is the pair's shared claim: nothing is wrong with the object, the trouble is in the text, and nobody has tried anything yet.

walk `remedy` from none to fence at margin or habitat. The exterior ground rises to the hall's level and takes its colour, the rim closes, and the marks that measured or inhabited the outside are simply gone - not covered, not smaller, gone, because there is nothing left for them to be about. This is Russell's fix and it is drawn in russell_set_box's own outer_color.

walk `remedy` from fence to reissue at the same form. The patch is identical - same footprint, same material, same 0.02 proud - and the pavement is absent, and a second boundary stands further out carrying the same aperture the hall carried, its marks in godel_statement_plaque's own glow_color. Two frames, one patch, opposite fates.

compare (margin, fence) against (habitat, fence). They are the same photograph to the byte, and that is the registered null: once the outside is annexed, measuring it and living in it are no longer different positions. Then compare either against (quotation, fence) - the smallest non-null difference in the fence column, and it is a plate 0.30 x 0.18 with its inscription sealed under a patch.

read `breach` at remedy=none against russell_set_box and godel_statement_plaque side by side. The hall builds the BOX's breach - a panel gone, its neighbours 6.5 and -5.0 degrees out of true - because the plaque's 2026-07-31 repair moved its own breach onto a different question, and that question is this bench's second axis.

dna.default: outside=quotation, remedy=none. THE OUTSIDE DEFAULT IS THE SOURCES', AND SO IS THE REMEDY DEFAULT, for different reasons. godel_statement_plaque.gd:141 and russell_set_box.gd:111 both ship `quotation` and both files gloss it the same way: an intact body with the limit written on it, which their promotion notes call a stance rather than a neutral rendering - nothing is wrong here, the trouble is in the text. remedy=none is not a starting cell chosen for tidiness; it is the sources' actual condition, because neither file contains any repair state at all and `none` is this codebase's spelling for an absence. So the default cell photographs the family exactly as it stands: a boundary with a small sign on it, an unpaved dark outside, and nothing yet attempted. Every other cell is a step away from that frame, and the cost is that `quotation` can no longer be read as a system in repose - beside twelve cells that show a repair being tried it reads as a system nobody has patched yet.
dna.was: TWO TOKENS, TWO SCRIPTS, ONE VOCABULARY WITH ONE IMPLEMENTATION - and it was checked for the wave-21 one-script-two-tokens shape first: godel_statement_plaque.tscn and russell_set_box.tscn name different scripts (GodelStatementPlaque, RussellSetBox) and the registry gives them different footprints (2x2x1 against 2x2x2) and different signals. What binds them is stronger than a copied word list. godel_statement_plaque.gd:151 holds OUTSIDES as the single allow-list and :577-697 holds normalise_outside plus four static builders; russell_set_box.gd:17 preloads that file as `Outside` and routes every one of its own values through it. Both were promoted on 2026-07-31 and both declare the five words in foundations.json. Their DEFAULTS agree too - quotation on both - and both files' promotion notes say the same thing about it: the intact body is a STANCE, the claim that nothing is wrong here and the trouble is in the text. Neither file has any repair state at all, which is why `remedy` ships at `none`: that is not a tidy starting cell, it is the sources' actual condition. What they do NOT share is `breach`, and the divergence survived because it was introduced by a repair whose own note asserts the opposite (godel_statement_plaque.gd:78-81).
dna.note: THE INSTRUMENT DECISIONS, EACH ONE COSTING SOMETHING. (1) NO TEXT ANYWHERE, AND THE SUBJECT IS A STATEMENT. Both sources carry real sentences - nine Label3D lines on the plaque (godel_statement_plaque.gd:154-176), five baked paradox tags on the box (russell_set_box.gd:463-475) - and at 760x760 with the sweep's framing none of them can be read. So the inscription here is FOUR RAISED BARS and no glyphs: 0.016 m tall, which is 3.1 px in the capture, visibly an inscription and carrying no reading. That is the honest size of a sentence in this evidence and the bench does not pretend otherwise. (2) THE FRAME IS PINNED, AND IT IS PINNED IN WORLD SPACE. One MeshInstance3D with a 2.40 x 0.66 x 2.40 BoxMesh and layers = 0 sits in every cell, so the merged AABB the sweep frames by is identical across all fifteen and no measured pair carries a framing difference it did not earn. Without it the pavement, the reissued boundary and the habitat field would each move the camera and buy a score. layers = 0 rather than visible = false, because Godot visibility is hierarchical and would take any future child with it - and layers = 0 still MEASURES, which is the whole point: capture_config_sweep.gd:1488-1490 merges mi.global_transform * mi.get_aabb() over every MeshInstance3D without consulting its layers. That same line is why the anchor's box is 2.40 wide and the framing radius is not computed from 2.40: the merge is in WORLD space, so the 0.62 rad face yaw turns a 2.40 x 2.40 footprint into 2.40 * (cos 0.62 + sin 0.62) = 3.347806 on both horizontal axes, and the radius with it. A headless instantiation of all fifteen cells returns (3.348, 0.660, 3.348) every time, which is where dna.framing 0.41 comes from - measured, not guessed, and the prediction below is computed from the measured number. (3) THE BUILDING IS YAWED 0.62 rad AND OPENS AWAY FROM THE VIEWER. capture_config_sweep.gd:69-70 puts the camera at yaw 0.62, pitch -0.26 and :443 builds its direction as (sin y cos p, -sin p, cos y cos p), whose horizontal bearing is exactly 0.62, so a child node yawed 0.62 photographs every front surface square. In the hall's own frame the view is then (0, sin 0.26, cos 0.26): a face normal to +z projects at 0.96639 of its area, a face normal to +y at 0.25708, and a face normal to +/-x at ZERO. Nothing that matters is ever put on a side face - the two returns and the back wall exist for body and are not asked to carry an argument. The hall opens AWAY from the camera on purpose: both sources invite you in (the plaque is a face you read, the box is a lid you lift) and this bench puts you outside the boundary, standing on the ground the axis is about. (4) OCCLUSION IS ARITHMETIC HERE, NOT EYEBALLED. Anything of height h hides the ground behind it for h / tan(14.9 deg) = 3.759 h. The coping stands 0.54 above the plate, so the 0.60 m interior behind it is wholly hidden and is never used for anything. The reissued boundary stands 0.20 at z = 0.62, hiding 0.75 m behind itself - all of it empty exterior ground - so every recurrence mark is placed BEYOND it at z 0.77 to 1.07, nearer the camera, where nothing occludes it. And it hides nothing of the hall: the wall face at z = -0.26 is 0.88 m further back, which the boundary would have to be 0.234 m tall to reach, and it is 0.20. (5) THE TABLET'S METAL WAS MEASURED, NOT CHOSEN. BRASS (0.40, 0.35, 0.20) sits at albedo luma 0.3498 against the wall's STONE.lightened(0.22) at 0.3174 - a sum|dRGB| of 50 out of 255, clearing the sweep's threshold of 26 by only 1.9x and liable to fall under it once FILMIC has compressed the highlights. The plate is therefore BRASS.lightened(0.34) = (0.604, 0.571, 0.472), sum|dRGB| 178, luma delta 0.2534. The PATCH plate over it is russell_set_box's outer_color (0.60, 0.30, 0.20) and is nearly ISOLUMINANT with the wall - luma 0.35656 against 0.317449, a delta of 0.039 - while its sum|dRGB| is 95. That is a fact worth stating rather than fixing: the patch is a different MATERIAL at the same VALUE, which is what a patch looks like, and it means the luma metric under-reads this bench while changed_pct reads it correctly. The prediction below is ranked on changed_pct for exactly that reason. (6) NO NUMERIC VALUE ANYWHERE IN EITHER AXIS. Both are @export_enum String with String defaults, so cabinet_sweep.coerce() has nothing to numericise and the tier_terrarium failure - Object.set() refusing a typed property in silence - cannot occur. It also means neither axis can be read as GridInteractablesComponent positional shorthand: no value parses as a float, so no key falls outside CONFIG_PARAM_NAMES and becomes a rotation. Both axes are hangable. (7) THE ONLY RANDOMNESS IS THE FAMILY'S OWN, AND IT IS SEEDED. `habitat` calls Outside.outside_field with a literal seed of 1931 - Godel's year, where russell_set_box.gd:293 passes 1901 - so five variants are five photographs of one object and not five objects. There is no seed export and therefore nothing for a dna.fixture to pin. (8) NO ALL-RUNGS VALUE ON EITHER AXIS, CHECKED PAIRWISE. On `remedy`: fence has the pavement and reissue does not; reissue has the outer boundary and the recurrence and fence does not; both have the patch; `none` shows the open aperture that both of them cover. On `outside`: omission drops all four panels and one post but never springs anything, so it does not contain breach; habitat and margin put different objects on the same ground. Waves 20-21 found nine union values in the corpus and this pass was written not to add a tenth. (9) THE .tscn ROOT CARRIES THE SCRIPT, so both axes are reachable from a map token, and apply_grid_config guards on the two keys it consumes before rebuilding - an unrelated key from any wrapper returns on the first branch. There is no await and no get_tree() call in that path, so a config that arrives while the node is detached cannot park on a process_frame that never comes.

predicted_degeneracy.pair: quotation against margin, in the fence remedy
predicted_degeneracy.metric: changed_pct - the share of the 760x760 frame whose sum|dRGB| exceeds 26 - and it is the right metric here because the pair is a GEOMETRY difference (a body present against absent) whose every pixel clears the threshold by 6.8x on the plate ring (sum|dRGB| 178) and 3.7x on the patch (95). The luma quantities are stated too and they are a DIFFERENT number: mean absolute LUMA delta over the whole frame is predicted at 0.0417 percent and the critic's focus - mean over the hottest 5 percent - at 0.833 percent, because the changed area (0.355 percent) is far under the 5 percent budget and the rest of the band is zeros. The luma figures are LOW for a real difference because the patch plate is nearly isoluminant with the wall (0.35656 against 0.317449, a delta of 0.039) while covering 66 percent of the tablet's area. That is the wave-22 lesson inverted: there, a colour-only change could not be RANKED by a counting metric; here, a genuine geometric change is UNDER-READ by a magnitude metric. Rank this pair on changed_pct.
predicted_degeneracy.floor_or_two_sided: FLOOR. The two frames differ by one solid body standing 0.014 proud of a lit wall under a shadow-casting key at rotation (-42, -35, 0), and a paper rasteriser with one light, flat shading and no shadows, AO or antialiasing cannot see the shadow the tablet throws onto the panel beside it, which lands outside the silhouette and is pure addition. Expect the measurement ABOVE 0.355 percent, in the corpus's usual 1.5x to 6.7x band, so roughly 0.53 to 2.4 percent. A measurement BELOW 0.355 percent is the one outcome that means the harness is broken rather than the design - most likely dna.framing dropped, or the tablet's albedo compressed under FILMIC until sum|dRGB| fell under 26 - and it should be investigated before the number is read as a fact about the axis.
predicted_degeneracy.pool: the FOURTEEN pairs the fence column supports, ranked among themselves. The only smaller number anywhere in the sheet is the designed null at (margin,fence)|(habitat,fence), which is 0.0000 percent and is registered separately - and because those two cells are byte-identical, (quotation,fence)|(habitat,fence) must return this SAME number to four decimals. A disagreement between those two pairs is a broken null, not a weak axis. Outside the fence column this pair does not exist as such: at remedy=none the same two outside values differ by the tablet AND the apron on disjoint regions (predicted 0.589 percent, the sum of 0.355 and 0.234), and at remedy=reissue by the outer tablet AND the reissued apron (predicted 0.550 percent, 0.300 plus 0.249). A rank inherits its context and this one is the floor only inside fence, for the reason the null gives.
predicted_degeneracy.why: UNDER fence THE EXTERIOR GROUND IS PAVED, SO EVERY MARK THAT LIVED ON IT IS GONE AND THE ONLY REGION LEFT THAT CAN VARY IS THE WALL. margin's apron and habitat's field are both exterior marks and are simply not built; quotation's tablet is the one mark on the hall body, and it is the smallest body any outside value adds - breach's patch panel is 0.3375 x 0.4400 and omission's is four of them plus a post. So the pair reduces to one silhouette. THE ARITHMETIC, IN WORLD SPACE BECAUSE THAT IS WHERE THE SWEEP MEASURES. The pinned anchor is a 2.40 x 0.66 x 2.40 box, but capture_config_sweep.gd:1488-1490 merges mi.global_transform * mi.get_aabb(), so what it sees is that box AFTER the 0.62 rad face yaw: 2.40 * (cos 0.62 + sin 0.62) = 2.40 * 1.394919 = 3.347806 on x and on z. Probed rather than assumed - all fifteen cells return (3.348, 0.660, 3.348). Diagonal sqrt(11.20780 + 0.4356 + 11.20780) = 4.780293, radius 2.3901465. The sweep fits at dist = radius / tan(FOV/2) * PAD * framing with FOV 34, PAD 1.9 and dna.framing 0.41, so D = 2.3901465 / 0.3057307 * 1.9 * 0.41 = 6.090091 m. (0.41 and not 1.0 because PAD 1.9 on a DIAGONAL radius leaves a wide flat subject at under half the frame; at 0.41 the plate's near edge, 1.15967 m closer than the centre at depth 4.930421, subtends 2.40 / (0.6114614 * 4.930421) = 79.6 percent of the frame width, which is as close as this shape can be flown without clipping.) The tablet's face sits at z = -0.253 in the hall's own frame, and the view axis there is (0, sin 0.26, cos 0.26), so its depth is D + 0.253 * 0.9663899 = 6.334588 m. At that depth the frame subtends 2 * 6.334588 * tan(17 deg) = 3.873262 m across 760 px, which is 196.218 px/m and 38501.5 px^2/m^2. The tablet is 0.30 x 0.18 on a face normal to +z, projecting 0.054 * 0.9663899 = 0.05218505 m^2, plus its 0.014 top edge on a face normal to +y projecting 0.30 * 0.014 * 0.2570806 = 0.00107974 m^2. Total 0.05326479 m^2 = 2050.8 px^2 out of 577600, which is 0.35505 percent. The patch plate is 0.2499 x 0.14004 and lies wholly inside the tablet's silhouette (0.833 and 0.778 of its width and height), so it adds no area - it only changes what colour 66 percent of that area is, which is why the luma number is small and the count number is not.

designed_nulls.why: IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION, AND THE NULL IS THE ARGUMENT RATHER THAN A CHECK ON IT. `margin` and `habitat` are the two outside values whose entire mark lives on the exterior ground: margin calls Outside.outside_measure onto it, habitat calls Outside.outside_field onto it, and neither touches the hall body. Under remedy=fence the exterior ground is ANNEXED - one paving slab at the hall's own level and in the hall's own material, out to a 12 mm rim - and the branch that would build either mark is guarded on remedy == 'none', so neither is called. Both cells then execute exactly the same statements in the same order: ground plate, paving slab, one intact run with fill = patch and nothing missing for the fill to supply, two returns, a back wall, the layers = 0 anchor. Same meshes, same transforms, same materials, no randomness on either path, no _process anywhere in the file - the two PNGs are the same file. Predicted 0.0000 percent on every metric. Anything above 0.05 percent is render nondeterminism; anything above 0.5 percent means one of the two ground builders is running under fence, and every fence reading in the sheet is then suspect. WHAT THE NULL SAYS: once the outside has been annexed, measuring it and living in it become the same photograph, because there is nothing left for the two stances to be stances ABOUT. It is not that the difference got small - the position has made itself unable to have one, which is exactly what ZFC did to the question Russell asked. AND IT IS CONDITIONED ONLY ON THE TWO SWEPT AXES: both `outside` and `remedy` are in the cross product, so the sweep renders these two cells. There is no dna.fixture on this artifact to pin anything with, so wave 21's UNTESTED trap cannot bite.

dna.designed_nulls_why: ONE null, and it is the only pair in the fifteen cells that is identical by construction. It was chosen because it is also the bench's clearest claim, and it was checked for the wave-21 trap first: it is conditioned only on the two swept axes, and this artifact declares no dna.fixture, so both cells are actually rendered.
dna.kin: `remedy` (none | fence | reissue) is a new word in this corpus and was checked against the near neighbours before it was taken. `evidence` (result | trace | longhand | axiom, 19 declarations) is the corpus's word for how much of the working is admitted alongside a result - a disclosure ladder over an apparatus in motion - and none of these three values is more-or-less of one thing: fence and reissue are opposite claims about the same act, not two amounts of it. `guard` and `enclosure` (exhibit_vitrine) ask what is between a viewer and an object, which is a question about access and not about repair. `keeping` (remainder_box, wave 22) asks in whose keeping a record is. The nearest live neighbour by SUBJECT rather than by word is critic_regress_stack in the same registry file, which asks what a justification rests on; this asks what happens to a boundary after you mend it.
dna.declines: FOUR, AND THE FIRST IS THE ONE THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN EASIEST TO SHIP. (1) `paradox` as the second axis - contradiction against undecidability, Russell's shape against Godel's. DECLINED because it is not visible: a contradiction and an undecidable sentence photograph identically. Both are a hole in the same wall. What differs is what you can DO about it, and that is what `remedy` photographs, so the honest axis is the consequence and not the taxonomy. This is the whole design decision of the bench and it is the reason the artifact exists rather than a diagram. (2) A FOURTH remedy VALUE - `patched_again`, a third boundary beyond the second with the aperture recurring a third time. DECLINED because it is a rate claim wearing geometry: the argument is that the recurrence has NO last step, and a still that shows three steps says exactly what a still showing two says while costing a third of the frame. It would also turn `reissue` into a rung on a monotone ladder rather than a stance, which is the shape `evidence` was declined for on critic_regress_stack (foundations.json:2166). (3) A SIXTH `outside` VALUE - `annexation`, the outside abolished, which is what fence does. DECLINED because the vocabulary is fixed by two shipped files that read it out of one allow-list (godel_statement_plaque.gd:151), and a third file adding a word would make three artifacts speak three lists while the gate reported all three green. The idea is not lost: it became a remedy value, where it belongs, because abolishing the outside is something you DO and not a form the hole TAKES. (4) REPAIRING russell_set_box's `breach` TO MATCH THE PLAQUE'S. DECLINED, and it is the finding, not an oversight. The plaque's repair note (godel_statement_plaque.gd:69-81) is right about Godel and would be wrong about Russell: naive set theory really was inconsistent, the box's own truth line (russell_set_box.gd:27) says so, and a shell sprung into two pieces is the correct picture of a container that cannot say what is inside it. Making the two `breach` values agree would erase the difference this bench was built to photograph. What IS owed is a note in each source pointing at the other, and that is a separate edit to files this pass did not touch.
dna.sweep_command: python tools/build_dna_gallery.py --slug=wave24-outside --tokens=outside_hall --max=15   # 5 x 3; --max defaults to 9 and would silently halve the sheet
dna.sweep_note: READ THE PER-PAIR ROWS, NOT THE HEADLINE. Two axes cross here and the headline is a PEAK: remedy moves the whole exterior ground and will dominate any summary, which is exactly how tier_terrarium's live channel axis hid a dead tier axis. The rows that matter are the fence column - where outside is reduced to whatever the patch had to supply - and the quotation/margin pair inside it.

spatial_needs.footprint_note: The ground plate is 2.40 x 2.40 and the built body reaches 0.60 high, so the piece wants a 2x2 cell block on its own axes - but it is measured at 3.348 x 0.660 x 3.348 because the 0.62 rad face yaw is INSIDE the artifact: 2.40 * (cos 0.62 + sin 0.62) = 3.347806, confirmed by a headless instantiation of all fifteen cells. Reserve 4 x 4. The yaw is part of the artifact, not a placement hint: it exists so the front face squares to the capture standpoint, and a map that rotates the token rotates it away from that.

outside_hall.qfep_connection: The thesis word, built as a place. Pure F-minimisation is impossible because every formal system has an outside - and this bench adds the part the curriculum needs last: one kind of outside can be legislated out of existence and the other cannot, so the difference between the two is not a fact about holes but about what a system does when it tries to close one.
